learningJourney.label: Learning journey
learningJourney.description: Learn about lac step by step, from fundamentals and biology to ecology, host plants and cultivation.
learningJourney.whatIsLac.title: What is lac?
learningJourney.whatIsLac.text: Start with a tiny living organism and understand natural lac resin produced by the lac insect.
learningJourney.lifeCycle.title: Lac life cycle
learningJourney.lifeCycle.text: Follow the biology and development of the lac insect from its early stages to resin production.
learningJourney.habitat.title: Habitat & host plants
learningJourney.habitat.text: Understand the relationship between lac insects, host plants, the environment and growth.
learningJourney.hostPlants.title: Host plants
learningJourney.hostPlants.text: Discover plants associated with lac cultivation and the basics of selecting suitable host trees.
learningJourney.lacFarming.title: Lac farming
learningJourney.lacFarming.text: Move from biology to practice: understand inoculation, care and harvesting.
